messages:
toni (Design): quick one — new region picker for compliance settings. trying to make it obvious which regions are encrypted-by-default vs BYOK-enabled. current mock: compact dropdown with badges. looking for accessibility + copy + keyboard behavior feedback. screenshots attached in thread :camera: mohit (Product): overall looks good. two product concerns: 1) default should be region closest to customer (we set via account) but let users override. 2) need a clear explanation of what `BYOK` means inline (most PMs gloss over acronyms). kevin (Eng): keyboard: current picklist is a native select fallback on older browsers, custom list on modern. custom list needs roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant. here's a possible pattern we already use: ```html
  • us-west-2 • Encrypted
  • eu-west-1 • BYOK
``` Kept minimal but we'll need aria-labels + live region updates on change. samir (Security): copy: avoid ambiguous words like "Encrypted" alone. better to say "Redwood-managed keys (AES-256)" and for BYOK say "Customer-managed KMS key (BYOK)". also we need to show whether audit logs will include region info and key id. request: add microcopy under dropdown: "Audit logs will record region and key id for compliance events." allegra (PM): about defaults — what happens when a tenant has no BYOK? do we show BYOK option disabled with tooltip? I think disabled + tooltip explaining requirement works. tooltip copy suggestion: "BYOK requires an uploaded key and matching IAM role — see docs." :thinking: toni (Design): re: copy — prefer short labels in the list and a helper row under the control for the details. mock updated: list shows short badges: "Redwood KMS" and "Customer KMS (BYOK)" and helper text: "Audit logs capture region + key id when customer KMS is selected." does that read clear? mohit (Product): short + helper is good. also request keeping visual contrast on badges (green for Redwood, blue for BYOK) and ensure color isn't the only signal — add a subtle icon lock vs key. kevin (Eng): about aria: don't put the helper text inside the listbox; instead associate with aria-describedby on the combobox so screen readers read it when focused. also need an aria-live region announcing the selection change: ```html
``` update the content to: "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key id." a11y-bot: automated checklist scan: - ensure combobox role pattern for custom picklists - aria-activedescendant updates correctly - aria-describedby references helper text - focus outline visible (2px) when keyboard nav - contrast ratio for badge text >= 4.5:1 (all items flagged for manual review) :white_check_mark: samir (Security): one more: audit log copy. we can't imply key material leaves the customer's tenant. propose exact phrasing for audit entries: "action: inference.request, region: eu-west-1, key_reference: projects/..../key123 (customer-managed)" Also we need to ensure that the UI copy doesn't say "key id" alone — use "key reference" in UI tooltips. toni (Design): noted. updated helper microcopy suggestion: "Audit logs: region + key reference recorded for requests using customer-managed keys." shorter alt for badge hover: "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) — audit: region + key reference." mohit (Product): UX flow question — when user switches from Redwood KMS to BYOK, do we show a staged confirmation modal explaining rollback implications and that past logs won't retroactively change? I think yes. allegra (PM): yes show modal: headline: "Switch to customer-managed key (BYOK)" body: "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. To complete, you must upload or grant access to a key." buttons: "Cancel" / "Continue". Also include a link to docs. kevin (Eng): technical: add a small notice in modal about propagation delay: "Changes may take up to 2 minutes to propagate to active inference workers." helps set expectations. toni (Design): small accessibility nit: we should set the modal's initial focus to the primary action, but set a focus trap and ensure screen readers see the modal label. also keyboard users should be able to close with `Esc`. samir (Security): testing checklist request: please add a prompt set for audit regression tests: ensure entering BYOK and switching regions results in correct audit entries and that key references are present. I can help add infra tests. toni (Design): thanks — I'll update the mock with the revised badge labels, helper text, modal copy, and aria patterns. will post a new screenshot. leaving a short punchlist here: - list labels: "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" - helper text tied via aria-describedby: "Audit logs: region + key reference recorded for requests using customer-managed keys." - color + icon not sole signal on badges - keyboard pattern: combobox + aria-activedescendant + live status on change - modal copy + propagation note + docs link - update audit log phrasing to use "key reference" mohit (Product): :thumbsup: can we also add a tiny inline "learn more" link next to helper text that opens the relevant docs anchor in a new tab? small analytics event on click. toni (Design): yep will add. thanks all, I'll push an updated mock and a short accessibility checklist to the design ticket later today.
